sentences.en: Nurture strength of spirit to shield you in sudden misfortune.
sentences.zh: 培养精神的力量，以抵御突如其来的不幸。

sentences.en: Deep inside your heart, nurture benevolence for everything that exists!
sentences.zh: 在你内心深处，培育对万物的善意！

sentences.en: Researchers study identical twins to solve the "Nature vs. Nurture" debate.
sentences.zh: 研究人员通过研究同卵双胞胎来解决‘天性与后天’的争论。

senses.zh: 养育，营养物；(总称)环境因素
提供营养：nourishment；培育，培养：provide with understanding

mnemonic: 联想记忆：大自然（nature）滋养（nurture）着人类
